locator: Request body; Question types; Answer types
quote: POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone takes state, model and questions. Noul returns yes probability without confidence. Choice returns highest probability option, full distribution, confidence, at most 255 options. Score returns probability-weighted ordered-level value, distribution and confidence, 2-10 levels. Question ids are not passed into inference. Independent questions share one state.

locator: Confidence is derived from the probabilities; Thresholds scale with risk
quote: Confidence is derived from probabilities: it is a statistic computed from the distribution, not another independent prediction. Choice and Score carry confidence; Noul does not. Page demo approximates three-option confidence as (3 * largest probability - 1) / 2. Thresholds depend on application domain and empirical performance.

Jev is literal; struggles with counting, numeric precision, dates, indirection, irrelevant long state, adversarial content and contradictory instructions. State is data but is not treated as hostile by default; injected instructions can move decisions. Noul and Choice outputs need not agree, complementary Nouls need not sum to one. Choices are relative whereas per-option Nouls are absolute and all may be low. Not trained for generation; use a generative model for text. Last reviewed 2026-09-17.

quote: Ordinary tool replay uses portable SDK pairs, untrusted labels and delimiter neutralization; 8000 UTF-16 units per pair, 32000 per stored assistant turn. Current chat retrieval fuses candidate legs by rank rather than raw score. The query builder requires scope predicates and fails closed without them. Optional vector leg joins lexical retrieval. Jev reranking would be an additional ranking hypothesis, not a shipped behavior.

Knowledge search returns owner-authorized file excerpts with kb:// line locators, warning completeness and continuation cursors. Current result assembly slices a page and preserves its traversal cursor; semantic reranking must not silently rewrite continuation semantics.

onFinish derives telemetry/status from abort and finishReason, drains durable deltas, adds cap notice if capped, and finishes the Run. It records model effort and usage. Semantic completion inspection would be a new advisory consumer; cancellation and cap outcomes are already runtime-owned.

Current web pipeline already checks text size/shape and known challenge phrases, and routes publisher Markdown, local render, llms.txt and raw fallback under admitted derived locators. A semantic content-usability classifier would augment residual ambiguous cases; it is not the first quality gate and cannot authorize new fetching.
